ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major crypto assets slipped sharply on the Delta India exchange, with BTC down 3.6% and XRP plunging over 10%, as the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate and broader market sentiment turned negative. The decline was compounded by bearish sentiment from Wall Street bets on a Fed rate hike and a BIS report highlighting gaps in Bitcoin on‑chain transfer estimates.
